interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.38.0 adds an optional typed message/source-binding helper and original bilingual synthetic controls for forged roles and poisoned successful experiences. Host-attested roles, exact hashes and separately bound observations are advisory evidence, never authenticated origin, truth or permission. The paired lifecycle runner uses actual persisted synthetic memory and fresh Python processes; defaults are offline scripted controls. Actual inference requires an explicit literal-loopback model endpoint and network opt-in. It is not an official Inspect AI adapter. The implementation-checkpoint local-model observation completed 16 plans without errors but met no strict pre-repair contamination condition, so repair credit is zero and efficacy remains unconfirmed. Existing declared source-span revocation and other opt-in tools remain available. Native discovery verifies both enabled skills and required bundled resource bytes, not application compliance. The seven certificate-bound checker files and committed LF harmless corpus remain compatible with v0.37.0 when installed bound bytes match. For older transitions where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Regeneration includes the harmless replay. Publication does not update active installations or activate a company vault. No default hook/configuration change, model/network call or runtime dependency is added.
